sloka: भगवन्ब्रह्मलोको ऽयं क्षुत्पिपासाविवर्जितः ।कस्यायं कर्मणः पाकः क्षुत्पिपासानुगो ह्यहम् ।। ७.७८.१२ ॥
transliteration: bhagavanbrahmaloko 'yaṁ kṣutpipāsāvivarjitaḥ ।kasyāyaṁ karmaṇaḥ pākaḥ kṣutpipāsānugo hyaham ।। 7.78.12 ॥

translations.english: O venerable one, this Brahma-loka is free from hunger and thirst, so what deed's consequence is it that I am indeed still afflicted by hunger and thirst?
